At first, I experimented with image segmentation technology, but most models were either too large or not precise enough to process multiple objects. Eventually, I discovered Apple's VisionKit. While it could only recognize a single object at a time, I realized that focusing on accurately identifying and displaying one object's name was enough for most learning scenarios. That's when I decided to make VisionKit the core technology behind SnapWords.

In 2024, my wife started learning French. One day, she asked, "Did you ever build that language-learning app you mentioned for our daughter?" When I showed her SnapWords recognizing and translating words, she was amazed. "This is exactly what I need!" she said. But the most rewarding part wasn't just my wife's approval
